limitations: Native IndexedDB writes use relaxed durability: no strict durable completion timing is claimed.
Persistence instrumentation times committed transactions containing all payload IDs (or update marker); full reconstruction and indexes are verified by native offline reopening outside timing.
Six local workers; sustained work serialized by shared lock, Atomic priority honored, OS/background activity uncontrolled. Browser-platform instrumentation overhead is included.
Wire counts exclude TLS/IP/TCP headers, retransmits, loopback framing and PG/cache/API internal traffic.

wire_definition.application: UTF-8 WebSocket message payloads after browser decompression
wire_definition.transport: server-to-client TCP stream bytes across dedicated proxy, including WebSocket frame headers and compressed payloads; connection handshake is excluded by timer snapshots

durability.persistence_transaction_ms: weaker IDB payload transaction complete acknowledgement; not fsync/power-loss durability

method.normal_replication: PG logical WAL -> zero-cache SQLite -> named-query WebSocket -> Zero native IDB
method.timer_start: after transport connected, immediately before materialize all unbounded named queries
method.indexes: Postgres primary keys only; cache derives native indexes; Zero native client metadata/indexes
